simple.summary: סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה (çûwmᵉpôwnᵉyâh) means a bagpipe (with a double pipe) First listed occurrence: Dan 3 5.

definitions.full: H5481. sumponeyah סוּמְמֹּנְיָה noun feminine , bag-pipe, or double pipe, or Pan's pipe (see GFM JBL, 1905, 166 ff. ) (Late Hebrew Levy NHWB iii. 492 ; Late Hebrew Aramaic סִימְלאסמּוֺן is tube , especially vein, artery Id ib. 513 ; loan-word from (late) Greek συμφωνία , Krauss ii. 376, 390 Bev 41 Dr Dan 3:5 Nes MM 37 (hence also later Latin symphonia , Ital. zampogna ), Prince KB 9230 ); — absolute ׳ס 3:5 , 15 , = סיפניה Kt, סוּמֹּנְיָה Qr 3:10 (Syriac id. ; compare Palmyrene ספון = σύμφωνος , in agreement, Lzb 330 GACooke Inscr. 338 ).
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) or סוּמְפֹּנְיָה ; (Aramaic), or סִיפֹנְיָא ; (Daniel 3:10) (Aramaic), of Greek origin;
